svg.title: A coin flip drives success down to zero
svg.desc: Nineteen arrows from the start to step 100, a cross for the stopped run. True reward: Qwen ends between 0 and 61%, Llama between 20 and 48%. Coin flip: 1% or less in all nine finished runs.
svg.text: A coin flip drives success down to zero
Problems solved at the first attempt, at the start and after 100 steps, five random seeds per model and
Data: twenty GRPO trainings of a hundred steps, one of them stopped twice by the gradient safeguard
